overclaims.statement: thinking about, experimenting with and developing relational approaches at least a decade before anyone else
overclaims.citedQuote: Gavin worked with Hilary Cottam who was thinking about, experimenting with and developing relational approaches at least a decade before anyone else (as summarised in her book Radical Help).
overclaims.rationale: The cited passage is a third-party blog's praise of a collaborator ('Gavin worked with Hilary Cottam who was thinking about... at least a decade before anyone else'). A promotional blog assertion cannot support a universal priority claim over all other thinkers; the dossier states it as fact.

overclaims.statement: informed U.K. Government policy from 2010 onwards
overclaims.citedQuote: the way that Gavin and Hilary’s work informed U.K. Government policy from 2010 onwards.
overclaims.rationale: The cited passage is a podcast feed link's summary saying 'the way that Gavin and Hilary's work informed U.K. Government policy from 2010 onwards.' A publisher-written feed description is not evidence of national policy influence; the dossier asserts it as an established fact about her work.

overclaims.citedQuote: Hilary Cottam, Founding Director, Participle, United Kingdom
overclaims.rationale: The claim carries effectiveFrom 2018 and presents 'Founding Director, Participle' as a current role, but the citation is a 2018 WEF photo caption; other sources indicate Participle was a 10-year experiment (2006–c.2016) and she later worked as an independent advisor. A past role is presented as current.

overclaims.statement: currently leading a DEFRA review on working life in England’s upland communities
overclaims.citedQuote: Hilary’s currently leading a DEFRA review on working life in England’s upland communities.
overclaims.rationale: The 'currently' derives from a 2022 podcast description; the dossier presents it as her present activity without dating it, so a time-bound role is stated as current years later.

overclaims.statement: Urban poverty specialist at the World Bank in Washington DC
overclaims.citedQuote: latterly as an urban poverty specialist at the World Bank in Washington DC
overclaims.rationale: The publisher bio places her as an urban poverty specialist at the World Bank in Washington DC, while the Wikipedia-derived claim (69ec611e) says she worked in Zimbabwe as a poverty specialist. The dossier records both without flagging the conflict, so at least one location claim exceeds what its single cited passage can establish.

usefulness.rationale: The dossier gives a clear picture of who Hilary Cottam is: British social entrepreneur, author of Radical Help (2019), founder of Participle (2006), former Design Council director who started the RED Unit, UK Designer of the Year 2005, OBE 2020, with her core ideas about relational welfare well covered. Understanding is good but not complete: sources conflict on her World Bank role (Zimbabwe vs Washington DC) and on whether she is best described as innovator, activist, or social worker, and the dossier does not resolve these. Remaining questions are partially handled — claims carry supported/contested/stale statuses, but there is no explicit statement of what the dossier does not know (e.g., current role after Participle, whether the UCL visiting professorship is still held). Conversation readiness is moderate: a reader could discuss her career, book, and ideas confidently, but current activities (DEFRA review, Participle role) are drawn from dated sources and may be stale.
